full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff inter alia is that the suit land originally belongs to Ahmed Ali Sheikh and Gendi Bibi who transferred the Property to his predecessors and others, Sahiruddin Khalifa and Mozammel Haque Khalifa. Sahiruddin Khalifa died leaving behind his widow Jamedon Nessa, only son Aminul Islam and two daughters proforma defendant No.3 Most. Jahanara Hasna Banu (Lily) and Jabedon Nessa died leaving behind her aforesaid heirs and the Suit land was recorded in M.R.R. Khatian No.100 Jabedon Nessa before her death filed a partition suit and the suit was decreed allotting saham of the Suit land to the respective co-sharers mentioned above. Plaintiff claimed that he purchased possession of the Suit described property and also described in the application from pro-forma defendant No.3 Mos. Jahanara Hasan Panu (Lily) a Co-sharer to the Suit jote on payment of Tk. 1,00,000/- (One lac) and went into possession of the same. The Suit premises has been described in the schedule as an office room with measurement and location situated on the roof of the suit market building and being threatened by the defendant with dispossession from the said suit premises by the defendant Nos.1 &2, he filed the suit and the application.
